name: @ijusttookadnatest/endurfi-mcp

tools.name: preview_stake
tools.description: Preview how much liquid staking token (xSTRK, xyWBTC, etc.) will be received for staking a given amount of underlying token (STRK, WBTC, tBTC, LBTC)

token_type.description: Token type to preview staking for

amount.description: Amount to preview staking (in token decimals)

tools.name: preview_unstake
tools.description: Preview how much underlying token (STRK, WBTC, tBTC, LBTC) will be received for unstaking a given amount of liquid staking token (xSTRK, xyWBTC, etc.)

token_type.description: Token type to preview unstaking for

amount.description: Amount of liquid token to preview unstaking (in token decimals)

tools.name: get_user_balance
tools.description: Get user liquid staking token balance (xSTRK, xyWBTC, etc.) and its underlying token equivalent value for any token type

token_type.description: Token type to check balance for

user_address.description: User address to check balance for (optional, defaults to connected account)

tools.name: get_total_staked
tools.description: Get total amount of underlying token (STRK, WBTC, tBTC, LBTC) staked on Endur.fi (TVL) for a specific token type

token_type.description: Token type to get TVL for

tools.name: get_withdraw_request_info
tools.description: Get information about a withdraw request NFT including status, amount, and claimability for any token type

token_type.description: Token type of the withdraw request

withdraw_request_id.description: The NFT ID of the withdraw request to query

tools.name: stake
tools.description: Stake tokens (STRK, WBTC, tBTC, LBTC) to receive liquid staking tokens (xSTRK, xyWBTC, etc.). No fees on staking. Rewards auto-compound.

token_type.description: Type of token to stake: STRK, WBTC, tBTC, or LBTC

amount.description: Amount to stake in token decimals (e.g., "1000000000000000000" for 1 STRK with 18 decimals, "100000000" for 1 WBTC with 8 decimals)

tools.name: unstake
tools.description: Unstake liquid staking tokens (xSTRK, xyWBTC, etc.) via the withdraw queue. Creates a withdraw request NFT. Wait 1-2 days before claiming. No slippage.

token_type.description: Type of liquid token to unstake: STRK (xSTRK), WBTC (xyWBTC), tBTC (xytBTC), or LBTC (xyLBTC)

amount.description: Amount of liquid staking token to unstake (in token decimals)

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Claim underlying tokens (STRK, WBTC, tBTC, LBTC) from a withdraw request NFT after the waiting period (1-2 days)

token_type.description: Type of token to claim: STRK, WBTC, tBTC, or LBTC

withdraw_request_id.description: The NFT ID of the withdraw request to claim
